title: It will do the job I guess
text: It will do the job I guess. I ended up returning but if you need a coffee pot, it will do the job. I just didn't like how it was made of cheap plastic. I don't like how you have to remove the water reservoir lid to add water. I would've liked a flip up type lid.  It will work fine if you need one, I just personally wanted something better made that's about the same price
